teaching_style: The current room lesson is authoritative tutorial knowledge and is repeated because each model call is stateless. Use the visible scene, WRAM outcome, curated map and lesson together. Decide the next action yourself; lessons explain the room objective and mechanic, not a movement route.
question_policy: If the scene and lesson do not support a safe action, request look_map or retrieve instead of guessing.

lessons.room_objective: Reach the next room while learning how visible dungeon monsters behave.
lessons.success_evidence: The party reaches the room exit or enters the next room.
lessons.lesson: Dungeon enemies are visible and move when the party moves. Touching one starts combat. The objective is forward progress, not exhaustive exploration.

lessons.room_objective: Pass the visible enemy deliberately and continue to the next room.
lessons.success_evidence: The party reaches the next doorway; combat is allowed if chosen or unavoidable.
lessons.lesson: Y uses the selected dungeon tool. An arrow can temporarily paralyze a visible enemy so the party can approach it deliberately.

lessons.room_objective: Solve this room's arrow-switch bridge puzzle and traverse the newly usable bridge to continue.
lessons.known_mechanic: A distant wall switch must be hit from range. Arrow is the selected and intended tool. The live screenshot and curated map reveal the alignment; derive the required position and facing from them.
lessons.success_evidence: The switch visibly changes state and the formerly broken bridge becomes traversable; confirmed movement across it is stronger evidence than merely firing an arrow.
lessons.lesson: This room explicitly contains a required puzzle. The locked doorway cannot be solved by walking into it. Align with the distant wall switch, face it, and use Y with Arrow. After the hit changes the bridge, cross it and continue through the connected doors.

lessons.room_objective: Open the locked door by leaving the pillar on the floor button.
lessons.success_evidence: The pillar remains on the button and the door becomes passable.
lessons.lesson: A floor button opens the locked door only while weighted. Hold A while moving against the pillar to push it onto the button. Reset restores a failed room puzzle.

lessons.room_objective: Use the intentional drop and ladder path to reach the next doorway.
lessons.success_evidence: The party reaches the upper route and enters the next room.
lessons.lesson: Use the marked drop point, then climb the ladder to reach the next door.

lessons.room_objective: Defeat both mandatory monsters and reach the right-side exit while respecting the room's elevation structure.
lessons.success_evidence: Both the green monster on the left elevation and the red route-blocking monster on the right are defeated, and the right-side door is passable.
lessons.lesson: The room has raised floors and a lower channel. Arrow-marked ledges only go down; ladders go up and make the opposite elevation reachable again, so either monster order is valid. Defeat both mandatory encounters, use the ladder beginning at AO12 to reach the right elevation, and continue right through the exit door after the red route-blocking monster is gone.

lessons.room_objective: Find and activate the switch concealed beneath a bush, then use the opened exit.
lessons.success_evidence: The concealed switch is exposed and activated and the next doorway becomes passable.
lessons.lesson: B swings the sword. Cut bushes that obstruct progress; one bush conceals the switch that opens the next door.

lessons.room_objective: Place the two vases on the two floor buttons to open the wall and final doorway.
lessons.success_evidence: Both required openings are active and the party can continue through the final doorway.
lessons.lesson: A picks up or places a vase. While carrying it, R plus a direction changes facing without stepping. Put one vase on the right button to open the wall, then the other on the remaining button to open the door.
